decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).

Condition : 4 - No development shall take place until full details of soft landscape works have been submitted to and apporved in writing by the LPA and these works shall be carried out as approved.  The works shall include planting plans ,schedules of plants and trees, noting species, size and proposed numbers and densities and implememtiation porgramme.non standard

Condition : 5 - All hard and soft landscape works shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.  The works shall be carried out prior to the occupation of any part of the development or in accordance with the programme agreed with the local planning authority

Condition : 6 - A landscape management plan, including long term design objectives, management responsibilities and maintenance schedules for all hard and soft landscape areas, [other than small, privately owned, domestic gardens] shall be submitted to and approved by the local planning authority prior to the occupation of the development or any phase of the development, whichever is the sooner, for its permitted use.  The landscape management plan shall be carried out as approved.

Condition : 7 - The low timber rail fence shall be maintained in the current poistion except for at he new point of pedestrian access to the site until such time as the new landscaping has been fully established to create a propoer landscaped buffer to the road frontages.non standard
description: Erection of perimeter railings to North, East and West site boundaries, new pedestrian gate to Kew Bridge Road,section of brick wall to ease boundary and erection of three condenser units to flank of Kew Bridge Road elevation
